g.text: Units 200 mm or less high: reinforcement
not more than 600 mm apart vertically, (1)(a)
than 3.76 mm diam, lapped not less
Or expanded metal strip not less than

svg.text: Glass block has horizontal joint reinforcement
of 2 corrosion-resistant bars of not less than
3.76 mm diam or expanded metal strips not less
(a) at vertical intervals of not more than 600 mm
(23⅝″) for units 200 mm or less in height, and
(b) in every horizontal joint for units higher
The reinforcement is lapped not less than 150
